description: Street Sweeping Schedules is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Public Works Department. This is a legacy dataset which contains detailed information on the timing and location of street sweeping service throughout the City. Daily street cleaning takes place April 1 to November 30 in most Boston neighborhoods (weather permitting), and over 400 curb miles of streets are maintained under the Daytime Street Sweeping Program. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Public Works Department. Its tags are basic city services, curb, curbs, legacy portal, maintenance. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
